answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 45 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 11 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 45 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 780 bought sponsors, each risking real money. The beacon test is the live device, the sable test is the locked stake, and the violet test is the graded history no template can fake.
